name: size
label: Modal Size
description: Size for the modal, exactly matches to size options of now-modal

name: disableDismiss
label: Disable Dismiss
description: If true, the dismiss icon in the modal is omitted and pressing Escape will not close the modal.

name: enableFullScreenInMobile
label: Enable Fullscreen in Mobile
description: If true, the modal will fill the entire screen on mobile devices

name: enableResizable
label: Enable Resize
description: If true, the modal will be resizable through its corners and edges

name: resizableMinHeight
label: Minimum Resize Height
description: Minimum height in pixels that the modal can be resized to. Default value is 133px.

name: resizableMaxHeight
label: Maximum Resize Height
description: Maximum height in pixels that the target element can be resized to. Default value is window's height.

name: resizableMinWidth
label: Minimum Resize Width
description: Minimum width in pixels that the modal can be resized to. Default value is 420px.

name: resizableMaxWidth
label: Maximum Resize Width
description: Maximum width in pixels that the target element can be resized to. Default value is window's width.

name: opened
label: Opened
description: If true, the modal will be visible

name: overlayPositionAbsolute
label: Overlay position absolute
description: If true, the modal overlay will be absolute position rather than fixed

name: label
label: Aria label
description: Sets the viewport modal title for screen readers
